content:
ivy: follow-up to yesterday's active/active notes. i want a compact preflight that rejects tenants which would break on primary rotation. goal: keep canary small and safe.

ben: agree. what checks do we do? my list: header-stability (do webhooks echo region), sticky-cookie presence, and tenant residency tag.

vishal: infra sketch: preflight phases: probe -> snapshot -> prewarm-ready. probe runs small traffic and checks for unexpected 4xx/5xx errors and header-dependency. snippet: `curl -H 'X-Region: probe' https://hook.example/echo` and expect region echoed.

mara: product: require opt-in toggle and explicit consent text for EU tenants even if probe passes. also users should be able to opt-out anytime.

claire: privacy: EU-residency tenants must only be rotated within EU. if probe indicates outbound integrations in non-EU destinations, block rotation and surface manual review. audit every decision.

ivy: technical preflight pass criteria (suggested): probe success rate >99% for 5m, no header-assumption failures, QPS < 50, and non-residency or EU-only target.

ben: operator signals: preflight.pass, preflight.fail_reason, probe.hit_rate, webhook_header_mismatch_count. add event to traces with `rotation.preflight=true`.

vishal: implement as idempotent endpoint: `POST /internal/preflight?tenant=t-900` returns JSON-like status (but we only store string here). include idempotency key and probe id.

mara: UX: show preflight status in console and let customer preview expected primary region. send webhook notification for canary tenants 48h before rotation.

rotate-bot: preflight-run queued id=pf-20240630-03 tenants=120 start=2024-07-05T01:00Z

ivy: rollout: run pf for 120 tenants, if pass rate > 95% expand. rollback on any spike in cold-miss-rate or p99 latency > 1.2x.

ben: add a fast abort flag for oncall. i'll draft alerts and the rollback playbook.

vishal: will prototype probe and compact vector-state metadata that preflight will consult. keep metadata <1KB per tenant.

claire: note: retain preflight logs 13 months for audit. i'll add retention spec.

ivy: action items: vishal proto (1w), ben alerts/runbook (EOW), mara console copy + opt-in (next Tue), claire retention note (next Tue). i'll post experiment brief and link here.
